blocks.html: Round off your exceptional safari with time in Zanzibar

blocks.orig: After days filled with wildlife, adventure, and discovery, there’s no better way to unwind than on the white-sand beaches of Zanzibar. This idyllic island off the coast of Tanzania offers the perfect ending to your exceptional safari – with luxury beachfront resorts, private villas, and crystal-clear waters waiting to be explored.
blocks.html: After days full of wildlife, adventure and new discoveries, nothing beats winding down on the white-sand beaches of Zanzibar. This idyllic island just off the Tanzanian coast is the ideal finale to your exceptional safari – with luxury beachfront resorts, private villas and crystal-clear water to explore.

blocks.orig: Whether you’re snorkeling in coral reefs, sailing into the sunset on a traditional dhow, or simply relaxing beneath the palms, Zanzibar adds a touch of tropical magic to your journey. From Stone Town’s rich culture to the serenity of secluded beaches, it’s the ultimate place to reflect, recharge, and indulge in barefoot luxury.
blocks.html: Snorkel over coral reefs, sail into the sunset aboard a traditional dhow or simply lie back under the palms: Zanzibar brings a little tropical magic to your trip. Between the rich culture of Stone Town and the calm of hidden beaches, it is the perfect place to reflect, recharge and enjoy barefoot luxury.
